summary: @ornikar/eslint-config 24.0.8 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated in-tree payload
details: Version 24.0.8 of this ESLint config package diverges structurally from prior releases: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (banner `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotation `WV8StW`, encoded literal table `n7gIxM`, decoder `hc1jfK9`). Neither setup.mjs, math_init.js, nor the preinstall hook are consistent with the declared purpose of the package (an ESLint configuration; `main: index.js` still points at ordinary rule files). Fetching an alternate language runtime for the sole purpose of executing an opaque in-tree bundle on `npm install` is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern; the obfuscated payload runs before any consumer code review on every install of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
